title: RSA Key Generator
description: Write a Zig program that demonstrates RSA key generation concepts using small prime numbers.
verificationTest: output.includes('p=61') && output.includes('q=53') && output.includes('n=3233') && output.includes('phi=3120') && output.includes('e=') && output.includes('isPrime(p)=true')
hints: RSA chooses two large primes p and q, then computes n = p × q
Choose e such that 1 < e < phi and gcd(e, phi) = 1
Use @mod for modulo operations and gcd from Euclid's algorithm
